import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory

ROOT = Path('/workspace/vesuvius-repository-audit')
sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT), str(ROOT / 'src')]
import zarr
from scripts import launch_proofreader as launch
from vesuvius_autoresearch.core import proofreader_session as session

assert Path(session.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(ROOT)
with TemporaryDirectory(prefix='vesuvius-session-cli-') as temporary:
    work = Path(temporary)
    ct, labels, output = (work / name for name in ('ct.zarr', 'labels.zarr', 'session'))
    for path, dtype in ((ct, 'u2'), (labels, 'u1')):
        array = zarr.open(str(path), mode='w', shape=(8, 16, 16), chunks=(4, 8, 8), dtype=dtype)
        array[:] = 7 if path == ct else 1
    ct, labels = launch._inputs(ct, labels, output, 8)
    config = session.recorded_config(ct, labels, output, 8)
    receipt = session.create_record(config, ROOT / 'villa/segmentation/vc_proofreader/main.py', session.DEFAULT_LIMITS)
    command = [sys.executable, str(ROOT / 'scripts/check_proofreader_session.py'), '--session', str(output)]
    before = {str(p.relative_to(work)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in work.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    valid = subprocess.run(command, cwd='/tmp', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    after = {str(p.relative_to(work)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in work.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
    assert valid.returncode == 0, valid.stderr
    assert before == after
    report = json.loads(valid.stdout)
    assert report['input_record_matches'] and not report['resume_supported']
    assert report['input_record_sha256'] == hashlib.sha256(receipt.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    zarr.open(str(ct), mode='r+')[0, 0, 0] = 8
    invalid = subprocess.run(command, cwd='/tmp', text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
    assert invalid.returncode == 1 and 'ct source differs' in invalid.stderr
    evidence = {
        'scope': 'Synthetic local Zarrs; real checker subprocesses from /tmp, no GUI or original data.',
        'valid_exit_code': valid.returncode,
        'verification_writes_files': before != after,
        'valid_report': report,
        'changed_ct_exit_code': invalid.returncode,
        'changed_ct_diagnostic': invalid.stderr,
    }
Path('/tmp/vesuvius-session-smoke.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps(evidence))
